fit: Measured mycotoxins in Turkish export and retail dried figs
assessment: Ochratoxin A and aflatoxin B1 were measured in two export-year groups and in a separate retail group. Both toxins occurred in some export samples. The study measured food products and provides no individual ingestion, Parkinson diagnosis or visual episode frequency.

fit: Measured aflatoxins in retail dried fig samples from Rabat-Salé
assessment: Six of 20 dried fig samples contained detectable total aflatoxins and one had aflatoxin B1. The author preview gives commodity-specific counts. Growing locale and individual outcomes were not measured in those excerpts. Do not transfer this contamination fraction to a clinical or customary intake.

fit: Cultured fungal isolates from Skoura dried figs
assessment: The 68 percent denotes 30 of 44 isolates from ten fig samples. The study describes fungi and processing. Toxin concentrations come from separate cited studies, and no Parkinson visual event was measured.
